retrievalProfile.description: A centered, high-detail portrait featuring voluminous textured hair and heavy metallic jewelry paired with a bottom-aligned glitch typography overlay.
excludeWhen: minimalist or clean-cut aesthetics are required
bright, high-saturation color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A square-format portrait of a woman with massive, textured curly hair that fills the upper two-thirds of the frame. Her hands are raised to frame her face, adorned with numerous large rings and stacked metallic bracelets. The lighting is soft but directional, emphasizing skin texture and metallic sheen against a dark, gritty background. The bottom of the image features large-scale typography with vertical 'glitch' or 'drip' distortions.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical hand placement framing the central face
Contrast between soft skin and hard metallic jewelry
Integration of typography into the lower torso area
Massive hair volume acting as a secondary background texture
coreInvariants: Voluminous, textured hair filling the frame edges
Heavy, stacked metallic jewelry on wrists and fingers
Vertical line distortions extending from the typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up portrait; the face is the focal point, framed by hands and hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the central vertical axis of the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves outward to the hands and jewelry, then down to the large-scale typography at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the hair and subject fill almost the entire frame, with small areas of dark textured background at the top corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted earth tones and warm browns in the hair and skin.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool silver and metallic greys in the jewelry.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep blacks in the clothing and background.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the metallic highlights and dark shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Monochromatic or desaturated earth tones only

letterConstructionRules: Uppercase characters with uniform stroke weight
Vertical 'glitch' lines extending upwards and downwards from the letterforms
Varying opacity levels within the text block
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are elongated or sliced by vertical digital artifacts

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the subject's chest and lower torso

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A thin, clean sans-serif for secondary text paired with a heavy, distorted version for the primary title.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight for the base skeleton.
Strong geometric presence suitable for heavy modification.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a centered portrait of a woman with massive, voluminous curly brown hair, hands raised to her face wearing many large silver rings and stacked bracelets, against a dark textured grey background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, semi-transparent grey uppercase sans-serif text at the bottom, adding vertical glitch lines that streak through the letters.

verificationChecks: Is the hair filling the majority of the frame?
Are the hands symmetrically framing the face?
Does the text have vertical 'drip' or 'glitch' artifacts?
Is the color palette desaturated and metallic?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the vertical glitch lines

mustAchieve: Integration of text and image through distortion
avoid: Legibility-first typography that ignores the glitch aesthetic

postGenerationChecks: Check for metallic sheen on jewelry
Verify vertical lines align with letter strokes
Ensure hair texture is crisp and voluminous
Confirm the face remains the central focal point despite the heavy accessories
Check that the text does not obscure the eyes or mouth
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait(Subject: Woman, Hair: Voluminous/Textured) + Framing(Hands: Heavy Jewelry) + Palette(Desaturated/Metallic) + Typography(Bottom-aligned/Glitch-distorted)
